candidates.heuristic_context: Target problem types: long queue times and delays caused by insufficient processing capacity. Applicable when cases wait before an activity because the resources able to perform it are saturated.
candidates.additional_context: 2391 occurrences served by 100 resources at 248% utilisation of the hours they are open. Arrivals 1.98/h against capacity 2.08/h — a contention ratio of 0.95. Mean queue 208.7 cases (Little's law). Waiting is 69% of the time a case spends here, and the service time of 48.010 h confirms real work is being done, so the wait is contention rather than calendar.
